mapper.update: UPDATE customer_session SET revoked_at = #{now}, revoked_reason = #{reason}, version = version + 1 WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND revoked_at IS NULL

UPDATE customer_session SET expires_at = LEAST(expires_at, TIMESTAMPADD(HOUR, #{hours}, authenticated_at)), policy_version = #{policyVersion}, version = version + 1 WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND revoked_at IS NULL AND expires_at > #{now} AND purpose = 'NORMAL' AND expires_at > TIMESTAMPADD(HOUR, #{hours}, authenticated_at)
